SELECT * FROM (SELECT FINPROD_ID as id, FINPROD_ABBR as text from FIN_PRODUCT where P_FINPROD_ID is null AND FINPROD_TYPE2='F16') de
de.id like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') or de.text like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%')

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID ,B.BOOK_DATE as vDate ,B.NET_UNIT_VALUE ,B.YIELD_TERM ,CASE C.INT_TYPE WHEN '01' THEN C.RATE * 100 ELSE (C.RATE*C.COEFFICIENT+C.SPREAD_RATE) * 100 END AS intRate FROM FIN_PRODUCT A JOIN BOK_STAT_BOK_POSITION B ON B.BOOKSET_ID=A.FINPROD_ID AND A.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO C ON A.FINPROD_ID=C.FINPROD_ID AND B.BOOK_DATE >=C.EFF_DATE AND C.INT_TYPE IS not NULL WHERE A.FINPROD_ID =#{finprodId} AND B.BOOK_DATE >=DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d')>=B.BOOK_DATE AND B.IS_SUB_PRD='N' ORDER BY B.BOOK_DATE

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID ,B.BOOK_DATE as vDate ,B.NET_UNIT_VALUE ,B.YIELD_TERM FROM FIN_PRODUCT A JOIN BOK_STAT_BOK_POSITION B ON B.BOOKSET_ID=A.FINPROD_ID AND A.P_FINPROD_ID IS NULL WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND B.BOOK_DATE >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d')>=B.BOOK_DATE AND B.IS_SUB_PRD='N' ORDER BY B.BOOK_DATE
